!== RecurDyn Format Example: Simple Pendulum ==
!
!====================================== Ground ========================================
!
PART / 1 , GROUND
, NAME = 'Ground'
, TYPEENTITY = GENERAL

MARKER / 1
, NAME = 'Ground.InertiaMarker'
, PART = 1
, QP = 0 , 0 , 0
, REULER = 0 , 0 , 0

MARKER / 2
, NAME = 'Ground.Pin'
, PART = 1
, QP = 0 , 0 , 0
, REULER = 0 , -1.5707963267949 , 0

!======================================== Body ========================================
!
PART / 3
, NAME = 'Pendulum'
, TYPEENTITY = GENERAL
, MASS = 1.0
, CM = 3
, IP = 0.01 , 0.01 , 0.1
, 0 , 0 , 0
, QG = 0 , 0 , 0
, REULER = 0 , 0 , 0

MARKER / 3
, NAME = 'Pendulum.CM'
, PART = 3
, QP = 0 , 0 , 0
, REULER = 0 , 0 , 0

MARKER / 4
, NAME = 'Pendulum.Pin'
, PART = 3
, QP = 0 , 0 , 1.0
, REULER = 0 , -1.5707963267949 , 0

!====================================== Joint ========================================
!
JOINT / 1
, NAME = 'PinJoint'
, I = 2
, J = 4
, Revolute

!====================================== Units ========================================
!
UNITS /
, FORCE = Newton
, MASS = Kilogram
, LENGTH = Meter
, TIME = Second

accgrav / IGRAV = 0 , JGRAV = 0 , KGRAV = -9.81

END
